rule: score < lower: below; score >= upper: approved; otherwise: review
objective: Disable automatic rejection; zero junk approvals on calibration, then maximize PC/EB approvals; upper is midpoint of adjacent negative and positive calibration scores.
cost_assumption: Avoid automatic loss of real signals; accept review burden. No numerical team-approved FP/FN cost exists.
evaluation_policy: Record fixed thresholds without retuning on evaluation. approved means model PC/EB triage only, never confirmed planet. Team adoption and license review remain pending.
